definition: Projected point-to-segment distance for this GPS/candidate pair (metres).
Length of the directed candidate arc between its two nodes (metres).
Zero-based distance rank within the observation's candidate set; ties share a rank.
Projection fraction along the directed candidate arc, from 0 at its start to 1 at its end.
Sine of candidate-arc bearing minus local GPS movement bearing.
Cosine of candidate-arc bearing minus local GPS movement bearing.
Distance from the previous GPS observation in the trip's UTM projection (metres).
Timestamp difference from the previous observation (seconds).
GPS step distance divided by the elapsed seconds, with a 1-second floor.
In-degree plus out-degree of the candidate arc's start node.
In-degree plus out-degree of the candidate arc's end node.
